icon:
Use case: logo-brand.
Asset type: Google Play app icon for the Korean subtitle creation and editing app "해비 자막".
Primary request: Create one polished, flat, extremely clean icon. A full square solid near-black background #171717, opaque edge to edge. Center a crisp white right-pointing video play triangle above two white horizontal subtitle bars of unequal lengths. The mark uses simple substantial geometry and balanced generous negative space; no typography. The silhouette must remain clear at 48 pixels.
Composition: Square 1:1, 1024 by 1024 pixels, icon centered with a safe area of 16 percent around the white mark. Triangle above, bars beneath; visually one unified subtitle/video symbol.
Style: Monochrome minimal professional software identity, flat filled vector-like raster geometry. Match an app UI with black buttons, gray borders and white surfaces.
Constraints: no text, no letters, no rounded outer container, no transparent area, no gradient, no shadow, no glow, no bevel, no border, no smartphone, no badge, no watermark, no extra objects. Full opaque square black background.
featureGraphic:
Use case: ads-marketing.
Asset type: Google Play feature graphic, finished Korean store banner for "해비 자막", wide landscape 1024×500 ratio.
Primary request: A refined minimal typographic banner for a real subtitle creation/editing app. Light neutral gray-white background, near-black text, sparse precise composition. Flat monochrome visual identity; no gradients or decorative effects.
Text verbatim:
"해비 자막" (large bold Korean main title at left)
"영상과 음성을 자막으로" (clear smaller Korean tagline below title)
"생성 · 편집 · 내보내기" (compact supporting line below)
Right side: a single large black right-pointing play triangle above two thick black horizontal subtitle bars of unequal lengths, clean flat geometry that mirrors the app icon.
Composition: Left 62% title and supporting text, right 30% mark, ample breathing room, all critical content within 10% outer safe margins. Precise Korean typography, black text, balanced baseline alignment, professional Korean software brand.
Constraints: no smartphone, no app interface, no reconstruction of UI, no additional text, no promotional prices, no claims about free/unlimited/translation accuracy, no badges, no transparent region, no gradient, no shadow, no glow, no 3D, no rounded cards or frames, no watermarks. The exact three Korean text lines must be spelled correctly. Full opaque clean background.
